summary: The project used CFPB consumer complaint data to examine and predict complaint resolution outcomes in retail banking.
The processed dataset contained 1,289,027 records and 26 columns after filtering for relevant products and the 2017-2025 period.
The selected model was Structured random forest, with ROC-AUC 0.8748 and F1 0.8802 on the test set.
The model results suggest that product type, issue category, company group, state group, submission channel, and narrative features can help identify response-risk patterns.
The analysis can support complaint triage, early-warning dashboards, product-level monitoring, issue-level operational review, and governance reporting.
The model should be used as decision support with human oversight, not as a fully automated decision system.
